design: Fixed publication-held-out diagnostic; new-paper test chosen before new model scores
primary_test: Flavonoids2012; Raphanus sativus radicle length;100uM;120h;>=50% inhibition high, <=20% low; intermediate unknown
training: Previously frozen 73-compound Li2006/He2011/Ambrosia2019 experimental pool; do not change its labels or chemistry
secondary_checks: Same four-publication transfer diagnostic, with and without shared-scaffold purging; no selection or tuning
assumptions: Source-specific extremes from incompatible species/endpoints/doses pooled only to test transfer; not a common efficacy estimand; identities provisional; not independent external validation of an intended use; low inhibition includes stimulation
